english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for caring for someone who is ill or tending something carefully, including a plant.
Pick this when tending means looking after a person, especially someone who is ill.
Use this when care means looking after a person, animal, or thing and meeting its needs.
Use this for caring for someone or attending to and serving a person's needs; it is not the specialized choice for royal escorting or obeying instructions.

examples.english: I nurse my potted plants every day and don't dare slack off.
examples.traditional: 我每日都照顧啲盆栽，唔敢偷懶。
